show.description: Naina, a struggling waitress burdened by debt and a dying mother, is forced into a dangerous situation that leads her to Krish. Unaware that he is the Prime Minister himself, Naina believes Krish is only the PM’s look-alike living a secret life. A marriage of necessity pulls her into power, lies, and national conspiracies, where the truth could cost lives and love becomes the biggest risk.
